name: Moj mir - lozh'
source:
Everyone has a few “rituals” before going to sleep.
On this night, which was no different from the others, dreams moved into reality.

My world has never changed before, but now I live in a completely different consciousness.
In it, I have friends, comrades, enemies, and even lovers.
I can be anything I want to be, do anything I want to do.

But how can that be true?

"My world - is a lie" - is a visual novel of dreams and unacceptance of future, past, and Their own thoughts.
You will be looking throught different eyes of the same person.

Different names, different matters, but in one way - its all the same.

Play nice, win pretty prizes.
